body:
Restart plan, revision 3 (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-27 ~01:16Z).
Status: POSTPONED. At 00:53Z Greg was sent "restart now" for master 69a02f72, after Legal R-LIB8 ended and Central was quiet. He answered via Asistant #2903: „Nie mogę przez najbliższe kilka godzin.” The Central hold is lifted and all held work resumed.
Not yet installed on the running Central build:
- 22781ce1: w-3346 detach scan.
- 641b9bc1: w-e12f.
- 11d1d110: w-32ed, definite relay writer-admission refusal instead of UNKNOWN.
- 69a02f72: w-a46f, one-line delivery row.
- Later landings will add to this.
Next attempt: when Greg says he is available.
- Opus2 gives a fresh quiet check: no cargo, FULL, evaluator or reviewer child running on Central, including other projects' runs that are background children of TermAl sessions (for example Legal's).
- Mail Engram::Fable 15 minutes before "restart now".
- Hold spawns and landings from "restart now" until Greg says it's done.
- Named roots are lost on restart (w-8f74); owners re-name them afterwards.
- Engram's bd4b is a CLI change and needs no TermAl restart.

Update (01:39Z): master is now f8560ab1f6d2607f596997e4a413ff8dde987969, which adds w-2f9d (listener preface deadline on the control clock, landed from WinB). The restart content is master f8560ab1 plus any later landings.

Update (02:27Z): master is now 995515bc5c74f853b37790e01c48d27ba05ca2df, which adds w-5c63 (test-only: src/tests/queue_pause_reason.rs). That landing changes no runtime code, so it alone gives no reason to restart.
